mechanism: St. John's Wort induces CYP3A4 and CYP1A2, potentially reducing azithromycin plasma concentrations and efficacy; azithromycin also has QT-prolongation risk which may be relevant with serotonergic effects.
action: Monitor clinical response to azithromycin therapy; consider alternative antibiotic or discontinue St. John's Wort; counsel patient on potential reduced antimicrobial efficacy.
